Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the run chase! The Indian players make their way out to the middle, followed by Tammy Beaumont and Danni Wyatt. Shikha Pandey will start with the ball.

Right then! England Women need 149 runs to win! They have a very good batting line-up and they will look to come out hard. India Women, on the other hand, would want to pick up early wickets. Join us for the chase in a while.
Shefali Verma is there for a chat! She says she was trying to play good shots. Says the pitch is good to bat on. Feels that 148 is a good score and believes in her bowling team.

England Women were decent with the ball. They did not get off to a greatest of starts as they were punished in the first 4 overs but came back well after that as they restricted India in the middle overs. Sophie Ecclestone had another good game while Katherine Brunt was slightly disappointing. Mady Villiers had a good game as well and the other bowlers too did a very good job.

India Women started off brilliantly with Shafali Verma, the talented youngster, showing off her skills as she played a fine knock of 48 runs. She even hit Katherine Brunt for 5 fours in an over and India were off to a rollicking start. But post the Powerplay, they slowed down and even lost Mandhana and Verma in quick succession. Harmanpreet Kaur played a very good hand and Deepti Sharma and Sneh Rana finished well for India. They would now look to bowl well and defend the score.

End of a decent bowling performance from England Women! They will be happy with the performance but they gave away some runs towards the end. India Women have given themselves a chance of getting back in the series but at one stage, they looked like that they will get above 160.
Boundary to end the innings! India Women finishes on 148 for 4! Pitches it up, on middle. Rana whacks it into the gap towards square leg for a boundary.
On middle, eased down the ground for a single.
Almost! Sees Rana charging down the track, bowls a quicker ball, on off. Rana heaves it to mid-wicket where it falls just short of the charging fielder.
Just a single! A flatter ball, outside off. Pulled away to mid-wicket for a single.
Pitches it up, outside off. Rana drags it to mid-wicket for a single.
On middle, eased down to long on for one run.
Sophie Ecclestone will bowl the final over.
Another full ball, on off. Sharma works it to deep mid-wicket just for a single. 14 runs coming off this over. Can India end the last over on high?
Charges down the track and eases it to long on for a single.
Just short of the deep mid-wicket fielder! Another full ball, on off. Sharma whacks it towards deep mid-wicket, where the fielder charges in but falls just short of her. Single taken.
FOUR! Deepti Sharma continues to chip in runs! A full ball, on off. Sharma slogs it just wide of deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
FIVE WIDES! Gift for India! A full ball, way down the leg side. Sharma looks to flick but misses. The keeper fails to grab it and the ball races away to the fine leg fence.
A length ball, angling on middle. Rana tucks it to short fine leg and runs across. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Single taken.
Yorker ball, outside off. Sharma jams it out to short third man and takes a quick single.
Sneh Rana is the next batter in. Freya Davies will bowl the 19th over.
OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Another one bites the dust! A slower full ball, on off. Ghosh hammers it straight back to Sciver, who takes a simple catch to dismiss Richa Ghosh on 8 runs.
A back of a length ball, outside off. Richa Ghosh looks to ramp it but misses.
On middle, worked towards mid-wicket for one.
DROPPED! A full ball, on off. Ghosh uppishly drives it off the toe end of the bat towards cover. The fielder there settles under it but spills it out in the end. Single taken.
SIX! More of these needed for India! Another full ball, on middle. Ghosh whacks it over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Just a single! Full ball, on middle. Sharma slogs it to mid-wicket. The fielder fires the throw to the keeper. Single taken.
Natalie Sciver is back into the attack.
Another tidy over from England Women! Around off, a loopy ball. Ghosh punches it off the back foot to cover.
Another flatter ball, on middle. Ghosh chops it to point.
Flatter ball, on middle. Flicked to mid-wicket.
Full ball, outside off. Sharma looks to drive but gets a thick outside edge towards third man for one.
On middle. Richa Ghosh looks to paddle sweep it but manages a top edge, just over short fine leg. Single taken.
Angles in a loopy ball, on middle. Ghosh looks to push but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Quicker ball, on off. Sharma jams it back to the bowler.
Darted on the pads. Sharma whips it wide of mid-wicket. The fielder in the deep runs across, dives and keeps it to two.
Who will come out to bat now? Richa Ghosh it is.

OUT! CAUGHT! Excellent catch from Katherine Brunt! Tossed up on off, Kaur looks to go over long off but fails to time it well. It goes towards long off and Brunt comes charging ahead and takes a very good catch. Kaur needed to stay out there.
Commentary.Howout: c Katherine Brunt b Sarah Glenn

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! Banged! 10 runs off the first three bowls! Flighted ball, on middle. Harmanpreet Kaur gets on one knee and slogs it just over the deep mid-wicket fielder for a biggie,
FOUR! Welcome boundary for India! Flatter ball, on middle. Kaur gets on knee and slogs it wide of mid-wicket for a boundary.
On middle, Kaur steps down the track and pushes back to the bowler.
Length ball on the pads, Kaur works it to square leg for one.
Shortish on the pads, Sharma looks to pull but it goes takes inside edge, hits the pads of the keeper and goes behind. A single taken.
Good length ball on middle, Sharma hammers it towards long on. The fielder comes across, slides and makes a good stop. Two taken.
Shortish ball outside off, guided to short third man for one.
Good length ball on middle, Kaur looks to heave it away but misses and gets hit on the body.
Full on off, Harmanpreet defends it to mid off.
Natalie Sciver is back into the attack. Her figures till now read 2-0-6-0.

DROPPED! Sharp chance put down! Full outside off, Kaur looks to go over extra cover but does not get the elevation on it. The extra cover fielder jumps but fails to hold on and the ball races to the fence but the deep cover fielder comes across, dives and makes a good stop. The fielder throws it to the bowler who fails to collect and another run is pinched. Three runs in the end.
Good length ball on middle, Kaur nudges it to short fine leg.
On middle, nudged to mid on for one.
Good length ball on the pads, Sharma looks to flick but gets hit on the pads.
Good length ball on middle, Kaur works it to the leg side for one.
Just short! Full on middle, Sharma looks to flick but gets a leading edge and goes towards long on. The fielder comes charging ahead but it falls short.
Freya Davies is into the attack. Her figures till now read 2-0-11-1.
FOUR! Good end to the over for India!  Shorter and outside off, Kaur cuts it to the deep point region for a boundary.
Full on middle, Sharma heaves it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Low full toss on middle, Kaur works it to mid on for one.
Short on middle, Kaur looks to pull but gets it off the bottom half to mid-wicket.
A loopy ball, on middle. Sharma charges down the track and pushes it back to the bowler.
Flighted on middle, Kaur sweeps it to square leg for a single.
Sarah Glenn is back into the attack. Her figures till now read 1-0-12-0.
Low full toss on middle, swept to deep mid-wicket for one.
SIX! This will release some pressure. Flighted on off, Kaur dances down the track and then lifts it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Tossed up around off, Kaur goes down and looks to sweep but gets an inside edge which goes past the stumps towards short fine leg.
Full on middle, Sharma nudges it down to long on for a single.
Outside off, punched to cover.
Floated on middle, Sharma pushes it back to the bowler.
Fullish ball outside off, Deepti pushes it to deep cover for one.
Good length ball outside off, Sharma looks to cut but fails to get any bat on it.
Fullish ball on middle, Sharma pushes it to mid on.
BEATEN! Good length ball around off, Sharma looks to defend but gets beaten.
Full on the pads, Kaur flicks it to fine leg for one.
Full on middle, Kaur defends it to mid on.
Katherine Brunt is back into the attack. 2-0-32-0 are her figures so far.
Flatter ball, on middle. Kept out watchfully. So, a good over for England Women.
Harmanpreet Kaur is off the mark. A short ball, on middle. Pulled away to square leg for a single.
Around off, pushed to covers for a dot.
Flatter on middle. Defended back to the bowler.
Loopy ball, on middle. Blocked out.
Who will come out to bat now? Deepti Sharma it is.

OUT! CAUGHT! Both the openers back in the hut in the space of four balls! A fuller ball, on middle. Shafali Verma slogs it but not of the middle towards deep mid-wicket. Natalie Sciver runs across, settles under and takes a brilliant catch. Shafali Verma goes back on 48.
Commentary.Howout: c Natalie Sciver b Mady Villiers

Commentary.Commentary: Mady Villiers is on now.
On middle, flicked to mid-wicket.
TWO WIDES! A length ball, way down the leg side. The keeper fumbles to catch it and allows the batter to cross over.
Harmanpreet Kaur makes her way out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! In the air...and gone! England Women finally gets the much-needed breakthrough. A fuller ball, outside off. Smriti Mandhana gets low and looks to loft it over covers but doesn't middle it. Hits it in the air and towards the cover fielder, where Mady Villiers runs back and catches it with ease.
Commentary.Howout: c Mady Villiers b Freya Davies

Commentary.Commentary: Tad fuller, on middle. Verma wrists it to deep mid-wicket for another single.
Just a single! Around off, slapped to cover for a single.
A good length ball, on middle. Verma clips it to mid-wicket for a single.
On middle, eased down to long on for one.
Short ball, turning in on middle. Mandhana pulls it with the angle to square leg for a single. A good over for India, 12 coming off it.
SIX! All the way, Mandhana joins the party. Comes around the wicket and bowls a full ball, on off. Mandhana lofts it towards long off for a six. The ball just touches the ropes and hence a biggie.
A low dipping full toss, on off. Verma digs it out to long off for one.
Around off, pushed to covers.
FOUR! Welcome boundary for India! A good length ball, on middle. Verma flicks it past short fine leg for a boundary. The fielder chases it but the ball wins the race.
Glenn starts with a slower ball, on off. Verma dabs it to short third man.
Sarah Glenn comes into the attack now.
Another tidy over from England! A full ball, on middle. Verma eases it down to long on for a single. Runs have certainly dried up for India.
A slower full ball, on off. Verma waits for the ball and pushes it to covers.
Full ball, on middle. Mandhana works it to long on for a single.
Around off, Mandhana cuts it to the point fielder, who slightly fumbles. Verma looks to sneak a run but was sent back cleverly.
Touch fuller, on middle. Verma wrists it to mid-wicket for one run.
WIDE! A slower length ball, way down the leg side. Verma leaves it alone for a wide.
Full ball, on middle. Flicked to square leg for a single. 50 up for India Women.
Freya Davies is into the attack.
Maiden for Sophie Ecclestone! Around off, driven to mid off. End of the Powerplay. India Women are 49 for 0.
A flatter ball, angling around off. Verma chops it on the off side. This is excellent bowling from Sophie Ecclestone.
Around off, pushed to covers.

DROPPED! Sophie Ecclestone drops it! Pitches it up, on middle. Verma powers it back to the bowler, where she gets her hand on it but puts it down in the end. Ecclestone will be disappointed as it was at a catchable height. Will this be costly?
Full ball, angling on the pads. Verma looks to flick but misses it and gets hit on the pads.
Flatter, quicker, on middle. Verma pushes it back to the bowler.
Sophie Ecclestone is back into the attack. Gave away 11 runs in her first over.
Excellent over from Sciver. Just two runs from it. Short ball on middle, Shafali pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Good length ball on middle, Verma looks to flick but gets a leading edge which goes towards cover where it falls short.
Full on the pads, Verma flicks it to short fine leg.
Slower ball around off, Verma looks to cut but gets an under edge to short third man.
Sciver got a hand to it but it was a tough chance! Full on middle, Verma smacks it back. Sciver bends down, gets a hand on it but fails to hold on.
Good length ball outside off, Mandhana guides it to third man for a single.
Natalie Sciver is back into the attack.
FOUR! Wow, stop everything you are doing and just watch Shafali Verma bat! Short ball on off, Verma pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary. 21 runs from the over.
FOUR! Make it 4 in a row! This is super batting! Short ball on middle, Verma pulls it over deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
FOUR! This is the best of the lot! Good length ball outside off, Verma waits for it and then plays it past the point fielder for the third consecutive boundary.
FOUR! What a shot! Pressure on England now. Full on middle, Verma whacks it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
FOUR! Boom! Take that, Katherine Brunt! Short ball on middle, Verma clears her front leg and then pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Full on off, Mandhana looks to drive but it goes off the outside edge and towards third man for a single.
Full on middle, Verma clips it to mid-wicket. Good over for India.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Verma looks to flick but misses. Wided.
Flatter on the pads, Verma works it to short fine leg.
On middle, Shafali defends it back to the bowler.
SIX! Smacked! Verma is looking good here! Loopy ball on off, Verma lifts it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie. The umpire checks if it is a six or a four. The replays show that it is the former.
Flatter on middle, punched back to the bowler.
FOUR! Welcome into the attack, Ecclestone! Tossed up on off, Verma goes on her knees and then slogs it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Sophie Ecclestone to bowl now.
Shortish on the pads, Verma clips it to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! This is excellent batting! Good length ball outside off, Verma guides it to third man for another boundary.
Full outside off, Mandhana drives it to cover where the fielder fumbles and allows the single to be taken.
FOUR! First boundary for India! Good length ball outside off, Mandhana opens the face of the bat and then guides it to third man for a boundary.
Full outside off, Mandhana drives it to cover.
Brunt starts with a full ball outside off, Verma plays it to third man for a single.
Who will bowl from the other end? Katherine Brunt it is.
Good length ball on off, Verma guides it to third man for a single.
EDGY! Good length ball around off, Shafali Verma looks to defend but it goes off the inner half to square leg.
Good length ball outside off, Mandhana cuts it to deep point for one.
Good length ball outside off, Mandhana punches it to the point region.
Verma is off the mark as well! On a length on off, Verma guides it to third man for a single.
India and Mandhana are underway! Good length ball outside off, Mandhana looks to drive but it goes off the outside edge towards third man for one.
We are all set to begin the second T20I! The England Women's players stride out to the middle, followed by Smriti Mandhana and Shafali Verma.  Natalie Sciver will start with the ball.

ENGLAND (UNCHANGED PLAYING XI) - Danni Wyatt, Tammy Beaumont, Natalie Sciver, Heather Knight (C), Amy Jones (WK), Sophia Dunkley, Katherine Brunt, Sophie Ecclestone, Sarah Glenn, Mady Villiers, Freya Davies.

INDIA (UNCHANGED PLAYING XI) - Smriti Mandhana, Shafali Verma, Harleen Deol, Harmanpreet Kaur (C), Deepti Sharma, Richa Ghosh (WK), Sneh Rana, Arundhati Reddy, Shikha Pandey, Radha Yadav, Poonam Yadav.
Toss - Up goes the coin and it lands in the favour of England Women. They have elected to field first.

Hello and a warm welcome to the second T20I between England Women and India Women. India were comprehensively defeated in the first game and they would want to make a comeback and push England back. They did well in some parts but a complete performance is remaining. England, on the other hand, were brilliant in the first game with Sciver being the star of the show. They lead by 8-4 in the overall tour scoreline and would want to wrap it up here. Toss and team updates in a while.
